test.prompt: Use only the configured Notion MCP tools. Fetch the configured Reports source at {{source}}, report its identity, URL, visible structure, and one concise factual observation proving report content was read. Make no changes.
test.expected_output: The configured Reports source is fetched and one source-grounded observation is returned without a write.
assertions: The configured Reports source is fetched successfully.
The response reports its identity, URL, and visible structure.
One factual observation is grounded in fetched report content.
The trace contains no write operation.

readiness.prompt: Use only read-only Notion MCP tools. Fetch the configured Reports source at {{source}} and inspect whether at least one readable report with meaningful content exists. Report counts and content presence only; do not quote content or make changes.
